scope: Finite reviewed-corpus gaps, not proof of universal absence

records.subject: OEM M64/60 crankcase alloy
records.missing_definition: Grade, chemistry, casting revision, metallurgical condition and hardness
records.research_route: Factory material specification and identified casting number; chemistry and hardness measurements on the exact donor

records.subject: OEM M64/60 cylinder head
records.missing_definition: Casting alloy, treatment, porosity acceptance and local chamber/port-wall thickness
records.research_route: Factory drawing/material sheet; CT or calibrated section metrology of an identified original head

records.subject: OEM M64/60 piston
records.missing_definition: Exact alloy, forging/casting process, heat treatment, crown and skirt thickness
records.research_route: Original piston part-revision drawing; identified specimen metrology. Aftermarket 2618/4032 is not a substitute

records.subject: OEM M64/60 cylinder
records.missing_definition: Substrate grade, coating composition/thickness and local structural wall thickness
records.research_route: Turbo-specific service material source; bore/coating section measurement. Distinguish per-side coating from structural wall

records.subject: Turbo magnesium parts
records.missing_definition: Individual wheel/housing/cover/pump material and exact Mg grade by part number
records.research_route: Model-specific Turbo material specification. Keep 964 chapter and 993 Carrera descriptions separate

records.subject: Titanium in GT2/Evolution
records.missing_definition: Model/year-specific factory titanium rods or valves and exact grades
records.research_route: Porsche Motorsport literature, Motorsport PET and identified homologation extension. FIA access attempt returned 403; no file acquired

records.subject: Water-cooled Mezger exact grades
records.missing_definition: 997 Turbo/GT2 piston, head, liner, case and rod grades/treatments
records.research_route: Factory component drawings and supplier material certification, beyond brochures naming material families

records.subject: Dimensional definition
records.missing_definition: Local wall coordinates, minimum values, tolerances, wear/repair state and uncertainty
records.research_route: Identified drawing or calibrated CT/section inspection. Overall heights, crown volumes and register diameters are different dimensions

records.subject: Original K16 metallurgy and speed
records.missing_definition: 6735/6736 wheel/housing alloys, heat treatment, rotor speed limits and measured matching maps
records.research_route: BorgWarner/KKK part-specific documentation and exact donor identification; balance rpm is not an operating limit

records.subject: Turbo/racing technical literature
records.missing_definition: Full SAE780718 and relevant Turbo Service Information Technik/Motorsport documents
records.research_route: Publisher, library or existing authorised subscription; abstract metadata does not establish unseen content
